f63092950f62.The largest available reasoning model in: Reasoning models are the most expensive and slowest per call. The scenario says frontier accuracy is not needed and cost matters, so it is overkill for simple classification.
f63092950f62.A GPT-4.1 frontier model on provisioned: A frontier model on reserved PTUs costs far more than a small model for a narrow task. The scenario explicitly does not need frontier accuracy and wants low cost.
f63092950f62.A multimodal frontier model with image i: The tickets are short text, so image input adds nothing, and a frontier model raises cost per call. A small language model fits narrow, high-volume text tasks better.

59dc3d8ffd7b.A text-to-image model that generates ima: A text-to-image model creates new images from text. The app must read an uploaded photo and answer in text, which is the opposite direction.
59dc3d8ffd7b.A text embedding model such as text-embe: Text embedding models turn text into vectors for similarity search. They cannot take an image as input and do not generate answers.
59dc3d8ffd7b.A speech-to-text model that transcribes: Speech-to-text models transcribe audio. The input here is a photo, so a transcription model cannot interpret the damaged part.

417f21a09666.Global batch deployment type: Global batch processes asynchronous jobs at a discount within a 24 hour target window. It does not reserve capacity or give predictable real-time latency.
417f21a09666.Global standard pay-per-token deployment: Global standard bills per token on shared capacity, so latency can vary and requests can be throttled at peak. It does not guarantee reserved capacity.
417f21a09666.Data zone standard deployment: Data zone standard is a pay-per-token deployment on shared capacity within a data zone. It gives no reserved throughput or latency guarantee.

8eb6c7b8d43d.Global standard deployment: Global standard charges full real-time token prices and is subject to rate limits. With 24 hours of slack, the discounted batch option is cheaper for 2 million documents.
8eb6c7b8d43d.Provisioned throughput deployment: Provisioned throughput reserves capacity billed by the hour for predictable latency. Paying for reserved capacity is not the cheapest choice for a job that can wait.
8eb6c7b8d43d.Data zone provisioned deployment: Data zone provisioned is reserved PTU capacity within a data zone. It is billed for capacity whether used or not, so it does not minimize cost for deferred bulk work.

2aedf325a694.The API key has been regenerated and cal: An invalid or rotated key returns HTTP 401 on every call, regardless of load. Errors that appear only at peak hours point to rate limiting.
2aedf325a694.The prompt was blocked by the content fi: A filtered prompt returns HTTP 400 with a content_filter code, tied to the prompt content rather than to traffic volume or time of day.
2aedf325a694.The request exceeded the model's maximum: Exceeding the context window returns HTTP 400 (context_length_exceeded) for that request at any time. It is not a 429 and is not linked to peak hours.

26415780fb3e.A Key Vault reference in the Container A: This still stores and uses an API key, just in Key Vault. The requirement is to avoid API keys entirely, which needs managed identity with Entra ID.
26415780fb3e.An Azure API Management gateway in front: API Management would still store the Foundry API key as a named value. The key is moved, not removed, so the requirement is not met.
26415780fb3e.Container Apps built-in authentication (: Built-in authentication signs in users calling the app. It does not give the app an identity for outbound calls to the Foundry resource.

60e7ce95fcd2.A network security group on the app's su: An NSG filters traffic in your own subnet. The Foundry resource's public endpoint would still be reachable from the internet.
60e7ce95fcd2.IP firewall rules that allow only your c: IP rules restrict callers but keep the public endpoint enabled, so the resource is still reachable from the internet. The policy requires no public exposure.
60e7ce95fcd2.Azure Front Door with a web application: Front Door with WAF is itself a public entry point and does not remove the resource's public endpoint. It does not isolate the resource from the internet.

42c590d89c42.A separate Foundry project per environme: Separate projects isolate environments, but manual portal setup drifts and is not repeatable from source control.
42c590d89c42.Azure Policy assignments that audit each: Azure Policy can audit or deny settings, but it does not deploy the infrastructure or agent and model configuration from source control.
42c590d89c42.A single shared Foundry project with rol: Role assignments in one shared project do not create separate, consistently deployed environments, and nothing is deployed from source control.

adcf4298c26a.Move the system prompt to the end of eac: Caching applies to an identical prefix at the start of the prompt. Moving the system prompt after varying content breaks cache hits and still bills the same tokens.
adcf4298c26a.Enable streaming so the long system prom: Streaming only changes how output tokens are delivered. The same input tokens are processed and billed, so cost does not drop.
adcf4298c26a.Lower max_tokens so the system prompt is: max_tokens limits the length of the completion, not the input. The full system prompt is still processed and billed on every request.

518b10384bed.Azure AI Language PII detection on promp: PII detection finds personal data such as phone numbers. It does not classify hate, sexual, violence or self-harm content.
518b10384bed.Microsoft Purview data loss prevention p: Purview DLP protects sensitive data from leaking. It does not score model inputs and outputs for harm categories with severity levels.
518b10384bed.Groundedness detection in Azure AI Conte: Groundedness detection checks whether a response is supported by source material. It does not filter hate, sexual, violence or self-harm content.

7e3a916c79ce.Protected material detection for text: Protected material detection flags known copyrighted text such as lyrics in completions. It does not detect attempts to override instructions.
7e3a916c79ce.Groundedness detection with reasoning: Groundedness detection checks whether answers are supported by sources. It does not inspect user prompts for jailbreak attempts.
7e3a916c79ce.Content filter for the violence category: The violence filter scores violent content by severity. An instruction-override prompt is not violent, so this filter would not catch it.

ad9ecc5e3f28.Relevance: Relevance measures how well a response addresses the user's query. A relevant answer can still contain claims not found in the retrieved sources.
ad9ecc5e3f28.Coherence: Coherence measures whether a response is logical and well organized. It does not check the answer against the retrieved sources.
ad9ecc5e3f28.Retrieval: The retrieval evaluator scores how relevant the retrieved chunks are to the query. It judges the search step, not whether the answer is supported by those chunks.

db935aec1369.Add a system prompt instruction telling: A prompt instruction is not an enforced control and gives no human sign-off. It also blocks valid large refunds instead of routing them for approval.
db935aec1369.Let the agent issue the refund and send: Review after the refund is issued is not sign-off. The policy needs approval before refunds over $500 are executed.
db935aec1369.Configure a content filter on the agent: Content filters classify harmful content categories, not business rules. Blocking text also does not stop the tool call or add human approval.

86405c6faca2.Azure Monitor metrics for token usage pe: Token metrics show consumption and cost. They do not record which documents and tool calls produced each answer.
86405c6faca2.Resource diagnostic logs with request co: Diagnostic request logs show call volume and status per deployment. They do not capture the retrieval and tool steps behind each agent answer.
86405c6faca2.Content filter annotations on each compl: Filter annotations report whether content was flagged for harm categories. They say nothing about the sources or tool calls used.

435c6d37d80c.Token usage and latency metrics for the: Token and latency metrics track cost and speed of the model. Retrieval relevance can drop while these stay normal.
435c6d37d80c.Content filter block rates on retrieved: Block rates show how often harmful content is filtered. They do not reveal whether search results are becoming less relevant.
435c6d37d80c.CPU and memory metrics of the hosting we: Compute metrics show load on the app. They do not measure search quality, so a relevance drop would go unnoticed.

1a47fbcc8ad8.Assign Contributor on the resource group: Contributor is a broad control-plane role for managing resources. It grants more than needed and is not the data-plane role used to call models.
1a47fbcc8ad8.Assign the Azure AI Account Owner role o: Azure AI Account Owner grants management of the resource and its projects, including role assignments. That is more than calling models requires.
1a47fbcc8ad8.Share the project's API key through Key: The key gives full key-based access with no per-user identity, so it cannot be scoped to the developer. It is not an RBAC least-privilege approach.

8e93fde2d2e4.Supervised fine-tuning (SFT): Supervised fine-tuning updates model weights with training data, which the question rules out, and it does not keep answers current as documents change.
8e93fde2d2e4.Chain-of-thought prompting (CoT): Chain-of-thought prompting asks the model to reason step by step. It does not bring your company documents into the response.
8e93fde2d2e4.Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT): Reinforcement fine-tuning trains the model with graded feedback. It is a form of retraining, which the scenario wants to avoid.

b3aab24218f2.To rerank retrieved passages by semantic: Reranking is done by a ranker such as the Azure AI Search semantic ranker. The embedding model creates vectors for retrieval.
b3aab24218f2.To split source documents into chunks of: Chunking is done by a step such as the Text Split skill. The embedding model then turns those chunks into vectors.
b3aab24218f2.To generate the final grounded answer fr: The chat model generates the final answer. The embedding model only produces vectors so relevant passages can be found.

3f1a74b4c367.JSON mode with response_format json_obje: JSON mode guarantees valid JSON but not that it matches your schema. Fields can still be missing or wrong, which breaks parsing.
3f1a74b4c367.Function calling with tool_choice set to: With tool_choice auto the model may answer in plain text instead of calling the function, so schema-conformant output is not guaranteed.
3f1a74b4c367.A few-shot system message with JSON exam: Examples in the prompt help but do not constrain decoding. The model can still drift from the schema.

1f32a18fb40e.Structured (JSON) outputs: Structured outputs constrain the response format to a schema. They do not let the model request a call to your API.
1f32a18fb40e.Embeddings (vector search): Embeddings convert text into vectors for similarity search. They cannot request live data from an order-status API.
1f32a18fb40e.Log probabilities (logprobs): Logprobs return the probabilities of generated tokens. They do not give the model a way to request an external call.

3015e1384930.The function's source code and its depen: The model never runs your code. It only needs the name, description and schema to request a call that your app or the service executes.
3015e1384930.The endpoint URL and API key of the back: Secrets do not belong in a tool description, and the model cannot use them. It needs a description of when to use the tool and a parameter schema.
3015e1384930.A unique name and example outputs, with: Without a parameter schema the model has no reliable way to form correct arguments. Example outputs do not replace a description and schema.

7bf14a7df92e.Azure OpenAI Chat Completions API: Chat Completions is stateless. You would have to keep conversation history and write the tool-calling loop yourself.
7bf14a7df92e.Azure AI Search agentic retrieval: Agentic retrieval plans and runs search subqueries over an index. It does not host an agent that keeps conversation state and calls your tools.
7bf14a7df92e.Azure Machine Learning pipelines: Machine Learning pipelines run batch ML workflow steps. They do not host a conversational agent with tools and knowledge.

0409844fb2ca.A single agent with multiple tools: Here two separate agents exist and work is handed from one to another. One agent calling several tools is a different design.
0409844fb2ca.A retrieval-augmented (RAG) solution: RAG grounds a model in retrieved documents. It does not describe routing requests between a triage agent and a specialist agent.
0409844fb2ca.A model router (multi-model) deployment: A model router picks which model handles a prompt. It does not hand off tasks between agents with their own roles and tools.

8ab84356beb3.Fine-tune the agent's model on exported: Fine-tuning changes model behavior but is not a reliable way to add facts, and it goes stale as the library changes. Agents use knowledge tools instead.
8ab84356beb3.Paste the document contents into the age: Instructions are limited by the context window and become stale. Knowledge tools retrieve only relevant, current content at run time.
8ab84356beb3.Upload both sources to the agent with th: Code interpreter runs Python on uploaded files for analysis. It does not connect to a SharePoint library or query an Azure AI Search index.

2f96973501ad.Data drift (distribution shift): Data drift is a change in input data over time. Stating facts not in the retrieved sources is fabrication.
2f96973501ad.Prompt injection (jailbreak): Prompt injection is an attack that tries to override instructions. Unsupported statements without an attack are fabrications.
2f96973501ad.Overfitting (memorization): Overfitting is a training problem where a model fits training data too closely. It is not the name for unsupported claims in RAG answers.

a99dce808e71.Raise the presence penalty: Presence penalty pushes the model toward new topics. It does not make sampling more deterministic.
a99dce808e71.Increase the top_p value: A higher top_p widens the set of tokens considered, which makes output more varied, not more deterministic.
a99dce808e71.Raise the max_tokens limit: max_tokens only caps response length. It does not change how random token sampling is.

f4d0ce12ab84.Zero-shot prompting: Zero-shot prompting gives instructions with no examples. The question describes including examples in the prompt.
f4d0ce12ab84.Chain-of-thought prompting: Chain-of-thought asks the model to reason step by step. It is not defined by giving input and output examples.
f4d0ce12ab84.Prompt chaining: Prompt chaining splits a task into a sequence of prompts. It does not mean adding worked examples to one prompt.

c315a6498669.Self-consistency majority voting: Self-consistency samples several answers and picks the most common one. It does not review a draft against the sources and fix it.
c315a6498669.Few-shot prompting with examples: Few-shot prompting adds examples to a single prompt. There is no second pass that checks and revises the draft.
c315a6498669.Retrieval reranking with semantic ranker: Semantic ranking reorders search results before generation. It does not review or correct the model's draft answer.

a2ad7c163037.Latency, throughput, token usage and err: These are operational metrics for performance and cost. They do not judge the quality of the generated answers.
a2ad7c163037.Hate, sexual, violence and self-harm sev: These are risk and safety evaluators. They measure harmful content, not answer quality.
a2ad7c163037.BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR and GLEU overlap sco: These measure word overlap with reference answers and need ground truth. They do not judge grounding or coherence of open-ended answers as well.

6d01128d3984.Raise the deployment's tokens-per-minute: Quota affects throttling, not which tool the model picks. Rerunning without looking at traces gives no insight into the cause.
6d01128d3984.Review the content filter annotations on: Filter annotations show harmful content flags. They do not show which tool was selected or with what arguments.
6d01128d3984.Redeploy the agent to a different region: Changing region or model is a guess, not a diagnosis. Traces are needed first to see why the wrong tool was chosen.

980dffcea250.Use the Azure Resource Manager endpoint: The management SDK works on the control plane to create and configure resources. It is not how an app calls models and agents at run time.
980dffcea250.Use the Azure Machine Learning SDK v2 wi: The Machine Learning SDK and connection strings belong to hub-based workspaces. Foundry projects are accessed through the project endpoint with the Projects SDK.
980dffcea250.Use the Azure AI Search SDK against the: The Search SDK queries a search index only. It does not connect to models and agents in a Foundry project.

a7b84155d638.Prompt caching: Prompt caching speeds up repeated prompt prefixes, but the full response is still returned at once. It does not show partial output.
a7b84155d638.Global batch: Batch jobs are asynchronous with up to a 24 hour turnaround. They return nothing to a live UI while generating.
a7b84155d638.Predicted outputs: Predicted outputs can reduce latency when much of the output is known, but the response still arrives in one piece without streaming.

b946d01bf927.Load balancing across regional deploymen: Load balancing spreads traffic across copies of the same model. It does not send simple and complex requests to different models.
b946d01bf927.Spillover from provisioned to standard d: Spillover sends overflow traffic from a provisioned deployment to a standard one when capacity is full. It routes by capacity, not by request complexity.
b946d01bf927.Distillation of a large model into a sma: Distillation trains a smaller model from a larger one. It does not decide at run time which model handles each request.

0735e2d38a31.Content filter block rate per deployment: Block rates show how often harmful content is filtered. They do not explain what drives the bill.
0735e2d38a31.Average response latency per request: Latency measures speed. Most model deployments bill by tokens, so latency does not show cost.
0735e2d38a31.Time to first token per request: Time to first token measures responsiveness for streaming. It does not track the tokens that drive cost.

9a0420fadd40.Grant the agent Mail.ReadWrite on all ma: Broad mailbox access increases risk, and logging only records emails after they are sent. It does not prevent harmful messages.
9a0420fadd40.Add a system prompt asking the agent to: A prompt instruction is not an enforced control. The agent could still send an inappropriate email with no review.
9a0420fadd40.Apply a content filter to outgoing email: Content filters catch harmful categories but not wrong facts, wrong recipients or commitments. Without approval, irreversible sends still happen.

d48b3681f9b4.In the agent's content filter configurat: Content filter settings control harm category thresholds. They do not define processing steps or tool calls.
d48b3681f9b4.In the deployment's model router setting: Model router settings choose which model serves a request. They do not chain extraction, an API call and summarization.
d48b3681f9b4.In the connected Azure AI Search index s: A skillset enriches documents during indexing. It does not orchestrate an agent's run-time steps and tool calls.

b047ba015274.A multimodal chat model such as GPT-4o m: GPT-4o mini accepts images as input but returns text. It does not generate images from descriptions.
b047ba015274.An embedding model such as text-embeddin: Embedding models output numeric vectors for search. They do not create images.
b047ba015274.A speech model such as gpt-4o-mini-tts: A text-to-speech model produces audio from text. It cannot create marketing images.

a4911d45c917.Text-to-image generation with a detailed: Generating a new image from text alone does not preserve the original product. The product would be redrawn and could change.
a4911d45c917.Image variation from the original produc: Variations reinterpret the whole image, so the product itself can change. Only a mask limits edits to the background.
a4911d45c917.Upscaling the photo to a higher output r: Upscaling increases resolution but does not change the background. It does not perform the requested edit.

6503fe9f0603.Use an image embedding model to store a: Image embeddings support similarity search. They produce vectors, not readable alt text.
6503fe9f0603.Use OCR to extract any text that appears: OCR only reads text within the image. Most images need a description of what they show, which OCR cannot provide.
6503fe9f0603.Use an image generation model to create: Image generation creates new pictures. Alt text is a text description, so another image does not help.

19afa97c8fa7.Azure AI Vision Image Analysis: Image Analysis works on images only. It does not apply analyzers across documents, audio and video.
19afa97c8fa7.Azure AI Video Indexer: Video Indexer analyzes video and audio but not documents, and it is not the Foundry Tool built around custom analyzers for all four types.
19afa97c8fa7.Azure AI Search skillsets: Skillsets enrich documents during indexing. They do not provide analyzers that return structured fields from audio and video.

9deeddeafad9.Batch transcription with Azure AI Speech: Batch transcription returns what is said, not what happens visually in each segment of the video.
9deeddeafad9.Dense captions with Azure AI Vision: Dense captions describe regions of a single image. They do not segment a video or summarize events over time.
9deeddeafad9.Speaker diarization with Azure AI Speech: Diarization labels who spoke when in audio. It does not summarize the content of each video segment.

3d153f12b7b3.Direct jailbreak attack through the user: A direct jailbreak comes in the user's own prompt. Instructions hidden inside uploaded content are an indirect attack.
3d153f12b7b3.Training data poisoning through the uplo: Data poisoning corrupts data used to train a model. Here no training happens; the model reads the image at run time.
3d153f12b7b3.Protected material exposure through imag: Protected material concerns copyrighted content in model output. Hidden instructions in an input image are prompt injection.

f6c15dd068c3.Prompt Shields for documents and images: Prompt Shields detect prompt attacks such as jailbreaks and hidden instructions. They do not score images for violent content.
f6c15dd068c3.Azure AI Content Safety groundedness det: Groundedness detection checks text answers against sources. It does not analyze images for violence.
f6c15dd068c3.Microsoft Purview sensitivity labeling: Sensitivity labels classify and protect data for compliance. They do not detect violent imagery.

bad7392eb4bb.Text-to-image generation with an image m: Image generation creates new images. It does not answer questions about the content of a supplied photo.
bad7392eb4bb.OCR text extraction with Document Intell: OCR reads text in an image. Counting missing screws needs visual reasoning over objects, not text extraction.
bad7392eb4bb.Vector search over image embeddings in A: Vector search finds similar images. It does not reason about one photo to produce an answer.

bd01624c5704.Run the contracts through Azure Translat: Document translation converts text to another language while keeping layout. It does not identify people, organizations or dates.
bd01624c5704.Index the contracts in Azure AI Search w: Vector search returns relevant chunks of text. It does not extract entities into structured fields.
bd01624c5704.Use Azure AI Language sentiment analysis: Sentiment analysis classifies opinions as positive, negative or neutral. It does not extract named entities such as people and dates.

ef7d2e456e5e.Azure AI Speech: Azure AI Speech translates spoken audio. Text and document translation with custom terminology is Azure Translator.
ef7d2e456e5e.Azure AI Language: Azure AI Language detects languages and analyzes text, but it does not translate between languages.
ef7d2e456e5e.Azure Content Understanding: Content Understanding extracts structured fields from content. It is not a translation service with custom terminology.

36ee62606f46.Key phrase extraction: Key phrase extraction lists the main talking points. It does not label reviews as positive, negative or neutral.
36ee62606f46.Language detection: Language detection identifies which language the text is in. It does not assess opinion.
36ee62606f46.Named entity recognition: NER identifies people, places and organizations. It does not classify the tone of a review.

e0a85a9f3648.Speaker recognition and text to speech: Speaker recognition verifies who is speaking but does not transcribe what they said, so the model has no text to reason over.
e0a85a9f3648.Speech to text and language detection: This transcribes the caller, but language detection does not produce spoken output, so the agent cannot reply in a voice.
e0a85a9f3648.Keyword recognition and intent recogniti: Keyword and intent recognition detect phrases and intents. Neither provides a full transcript or a natural voice reply.

38642271a453.Use a custom neural voice trained on rec: Custom neural voice changes how text is spoken. It does not improve recognition of what callers say.
38642271a453.Switch to batch transcription with speak: Batch mode and diarization change timing and speaker labels. They do not teach the model domain vocabulary.
38642271a453.Enable profanity masking and set the rec: Profanity masking and language identification do not add product names to the recognizer's vocabulary.

e494a276af96.Document translation: Document translation translates files asynchronously. It does not take live spoken audio or produce speech.
e494a276af96.Real-time speech to text: Speech to text transcribes in the same language. It does not translate into Spanish speech.
e494a276af96.Custom neural voice: Custom neural voice creates a branded synthetic voice. It does not recognize or translate the presenter's speech.

3f1d435da1bc.Content Safety text moderation: Text moderation scores harmful content categories. It does not find and redact phone numbers or other personal data.
3f1d435da1bc.Protected material detection: Protected material detection flags known copyrighted text. It does not detect personal data.
3f1d435da1bc.Prompt Shields for documents: Prompt Shields detect prompt injection attacks in documents. They do not redact personal information.

03267db4413d.Train a custom foundation model from scr: Training from scratch is very costly and needs huge data. Prompting with format and examples is the practical first step.
03267db4413d.Fine-tune the model first, then add the: Fine-tuning is considered only after prompt design and examples fail to reach quality. Starting with it adds cost and effort.
03267db4413d.Raise the temperature and max_tokens so: Higher temperature makes output more varied, which works against a fixed house format. max_tokens only limits length.

a9fb84621ad2.Semantic ranking: Semantic ranking reranks top results with a language model. It does not run keyword and vector queries together.
a9fb84621ad2.Multivector search: A multivector query searches several vector fields at once. It does not include BM25 keyword results.
a9fb84621ad2.Full-text search: Full-text search uses BM25 keyword matching only. It does not include vector results.

01ebeb5b1eab.Scoring profiles: Scoring profiles boost results using field weights and functions such as freshness. They are rule-based, not a model-based reranker.
01ebeb5b1eab.Hybrid search with RRF: Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges keyword and vector rankings by formula. It is not a language model that rescores passages.
01ebeb5b1eab.Synonym maps: Synonym maps expand query terms with equivalents. They do not rerank results with a model.

3d33a2c23257.A semantic configuration with prioritize: A semantic configuration tells the semantic ranker which fields to use. It does not chunk or embed documents during indexing.
3d33a2c23257.A vector profile with an HNSW algorithm: A vector profile defines how vectors are indexed and searched. It does not create chunks or embeddings on its own.
3d33a2c23257.Push API uploads with precomputed vector: Pushing precomputed vectors means you chunk and embed outside the service. The requirement is for Search to do it automatically.

f49d27771102.Text Split skill for chunking: Text Split divides existing text into chunks. Scanned PDFs have no text until OCR extracts it.
f49d27771102.Image Analysis skill (captions): Image Analysis describes and tags images. It does not extract the printed text from scanned pages.
f49d27771102.Named entity recognition (NER): NER finds entities in text that already exists. It cannot read text from page images.

5517add41bf1.A semantic configuration: A semantic configuration sets fields for semantic ranking at query time. It does not run AI skills during indexing.
5517add41bf1.A scoring profile (ranking): A scoring profile adjusts relevance scores at query time. It does not enrich content during indexing.
5517add41bf1.A data source connection: A data source tells the indexer where content lives. It does not apply AI skills to the content.

b1359cbe9a7a.Azure AI Search full-text indexing of th: Keyword search finds documents containing terms. It does not extract fields and line items into clean structured output.
b1359cbe9a7a.Azure AI Vision Image Analysis captions: Captions describe what an image shows in general terms. They do not extract invoice numbers, vendors or line item tables.
b1359cbe9a7a.Azure AI Language key phrase extraction: Key phrase extraction lists main topics. It does not understand layout or return specific fields and line items.

53f26cdde584.Plain text with formatting removed: Removing formatting loses headings and tables, which are the structure downstream reasoning relies on.
53f26cdde584.Base64-encoded PDF page images: Page images contain no machine-readable text structure, so chunking and reasoning cannot use headings and tables.
53f26cdde584.JSON of OCR words and bounding boxes: A word list with coordinates keeps position but not headings and table structure in a form that is easy to chunk.

f126259bde54.Export the index to JSON and upload it t: Code interpreter runs Python on files for analysis. It does not run search queries against the index at run time.
f126259bde54.Copy the top index documents into the ag: Static copies go stale and are limited by context size. The agent should query the index at run time through a tool.
f126259bde54.Attach the index's indexer and skillset: Indexers and skillsets load and enrich content into the index. They do not let the agent query the index during a conversation.

0633ad59579e.User prompt attack detection, scanning t: User prompt attack detection targets jailbreak attempts the user writes. The injected line came from a third-party email the user did not write, which is a document attack.
0633ad59579e.Groundedness detection, scanning the mod: Groundedness detection checks whether output is supported by source material. It does not detect instructions injected into grounding content.
0633ad59579e.Protected material detection, scanning c: Protected material detection flags output that matches known copyrighted text or code. It does not look for malicious instructions hidden in emails.

136e3f308674.Role-play with an unrestricted persona: Role-play attacks ask the model to adopt a persona without limits. This message fabricates earlier dialogue turns, which is the conversation mockup technique.
136e3f308674.Encoding attack with transformed text: Encoding attacks hide instructions with ciphers or character transformations. The message here uses plain fake assistant and user turns, not encoded text.
136e3f308674.Manipulated content in grounding data: Manipulated content is a document attack subtype about falsified information in third-party content. This attack is written directly by the user as fake conversation turns.

68141b98797c.\"detected\": true and \"filtered\": tru: This is what a blocking configuration reports. In annotate-only mode the attack is detected but the content is not filtered.
68141b98797c.\"detected\": false and \"filtered\": fa: This means no attack was found. The question states the attack was detected, so detected must be true.
68141b98797c.\"detected\": false and \"filtered\": tr: This combination is inconsistent: content cannot be filtered for an attack that was not detected. In annotate-only mode the attack is detected but left unfiltered.

334dbf9fe1a2.Prompt Shields for user prompts: Prompt Shields for user prompts scan the user's own message for jailbreaks. They do not mark retrieved documents as lower-trust content.
334dbf9fe1a2.Groundedness detection with reasoning: Groundedness detection with reasoning explains whether output is supported by sources. It does not stop the model from following instructions inside documents.
334dbf9fe1a2.Protected material detection for text: Protected material detection for text flags output that matches known copyrighted text. It offers no protection against instructions embedded in retrieved documents.

d960468f017d.The response returns HTTP 400 with error: HTTP 400 with code content_filter is how a filtered prompt is reported. A filtered completion returns HTTP 200 with finish_reason content_filter.
d960468f017d.The prompt_filter_results entry shows fi: prompt_filter_results describes the prompt, not the output. A filtered prompt would be rejected with HTTP 400 instead of a completion.
d960468f017d.The finish_reason is stop and the choice: finish_reason stop means the model finished normally. A filtered output is marked with finish_reason content_filter.

605f89ff26d7.Protected material detection for text: The text variant targets known text such as song lyrics, articles and recipes. Licensed source code is covered by the code variant.
605f89ff26d7.Prompt Shields for document attacks: Document attack detection looks for injected instructions in grounding content. It does not compare generated code with licensed repositories.
605f89ff26d7.Groundedness detection with correction: Groundedness correction rewrites unsupported claims to match source material. It does not detect verbatim matches with protected code.

187a21fc5c61.A shared user-assigned managed identity: A shared managed identity gives every agent the same identity. The requirement is that each agent calls the API with its own identity.
187a21fc5c61.The Foundry project managed identity for: The project managed identity is shared by all agents in the project. It does not give each agent a separate identity for scoped access.
187a21fc5c61.A connection with an API key stored in K: Storing the key in Key Vault protects the secret, but every agent still uses the same shared key. That does not give each agent its own identity.

778e6331930a.Agent identity with application permissi: Application permissions let the agent act with its own rights across the tenant. They are not limited to what the signed-in user can see.
778e6331930a.Key-based authentication with a stored k: A stored key gives the same access for every caller. It cannot restrict the agent to the signed-in user's own mailbox permissions.
778e6331930a.Project managed identity with Mail.Read: Mail.Read granted to a managed identity is an application permission that can read every mailbox. It ignores the signed-in user's access limits.

1c1242e7f639.Set require_approval to always for every: Approval only pauses each call for a human decision. The agent still has all 40 tools available, so it does not enforce least privilege.
1c1242e7f639.List the three allowed tools in the agen: Instructions only ask the model to comply and are not enforced. Restricting the allowed tools in the agent configuration actually limits access.
1c1242e7f639.Put the MCP server behind a private endp: A private endpoint limits network reach to the server. The agent can still call every tool the server exposes.

0495fb66bd8c.Use the basic agent setup with a private: The basic setup stores conversation state in Microsoft-managed resources. Private endpoints and customer-managed keys secure access and encryption but do not move the data into your subscription.
0495fb66bd8c.Enable diagnostic settings to stream age: Diagnostic settings send logs and metrics, not the agent's conversation state store. Threads would still be stored in Microsoft-managed resources.
0495fb66bd8c.Deploy the model as Data Zone Standard i: Data Zone deployments control where inference is processed. They do not change where agent conversation state is stored.

6264f81adf5e.Intent resolution: Intent resolution measures whether the agent understood what the user wanted. It does not check whether the right tool was called with correct arguments.
6264f81adf5e.Task adherence: Task adherence checks whether the agent's response follows its assigned task and instructions. It is not focused on tool selection and argument correctness.
6264f81adf5e.Response completeness: Response completeness compares a response with expected information in ground truth. It does not evaluate the agent's tool calls.

72abbc3b9747.Prompt Shields in annotate-only mode: Prompt Shields detect attacks in incoming prompts and documents at run time. They do not generate adversarial attacks against your app.
72abbc3b9747.The groundedness evaluator in Foundry: The groundedness evaluator scores whether answers are supported by sources. It does not run attack strategies to probe for harmful output.
72abbc3b9747.Content Safety Studio moderation tests: Content Safety Studio lets you try moderation on sample content. It does not automate adversarial probing across many attack strategies.

f921a49072d6.HTTP 200 with finish_reason content_filt: This is the response when the generated output is filtered. A filtered prompt is rejected before generation with HTTP 400.
f921a49072d6.HTTP 200 with prompt_filter_results show: prompt_filter_results appear on successful responses where the prompt passed. A prompt that trips the filter is rejected with HTTP 400 instead.
f921a49072d6.HTTP 403 with error code content_filter: A filtered prompt returns HTTP 400, not 403. The 403 status is used for authorization failures.

4c73db096914.Global Standard deployment in an EU regi: Global Standard can process data in any Azure region worldwide, even when the resource is in the EU. That breaks the EU-only processing requirement.
4c73db096914.Standard deployment in a single EU regio: A regional Standard deployment keeps processing in one region, but it is limited to that region's capacity. The requirement asks for more than one region offers.
4c73db096914.Global Provisioned deployment in an EU r: Global provisioned deployments can also process data in any Azure region. They do not keep processing within EU datacenters.

bef2e9c97861.Switch the deployment to Data Zone Stand: Data Zone Standard is still pay-as-you-go without reserved capacity. Spikes can still return 429 errors, and its routing area is narrower than Global.
bef2e9c97861.Add client retry logic with exponential: Retries smooth over occasional 429s but add delay and do not reserve capacity. The business cannot accept the throttling and latency targets would be missed.
bef2e9c97861.Move all traffic to a Global Batch deplo: Batch deployments process requests asynchronously within 24 hours. They do not meet real-time latency targets.

14ad803ccb18.Caching needs at least 1,024 identical t: The 3,000-token policy already exceeds the 1,024-token minimum, and splitting it does not help. The cache misses because the variable question comes first.
14ad803ccb18.Caching needs temperature 0, so sampling: Prompt caching does not depend on temperature. Cache hits come from an identical prompt prefix.
14ad803ccb18.Caching needs the prompt_cache_key param: Prompt caching is enabled by default for supported models and needs no extra parameter. The problem is the order of the prompt.

top_p is another sampling parameter that most reasoning models also reject. It would cause the same kind of unsupported parameter error.
c463d203a50f.Keep temperature and switch max_tokens t: Switching to max_completion_tokens is correct for reasoning models, but temperature is still sent and still rejected.
c463d203a50f.Remove temperature and lower frequency_p: Removing temperature helps, but most reasoning models also reject frequency and presence penalties. That would cause another unsupported parameter error.

1acedd6d107d.reasoning_effort is set to low, so the m: Low reasoning effort uses fewer reasoning tokens and makes running out less likely. It does not cause the model to skip its visible answer.
1acedd6d107d.The developer message is missing, so the: A developer message is optional. Leaving it out does not produce an incomplete response with no text.
1acedd6d107d.Streaming was disabled, so reasoning sum: Streaming only changes how output is delivered. It does not replace visible text or cause an incomplete status.

16a0879cfcb6.assistant: The assistant role holds the model's own previous replies. It does not carry the system-style instructions that guide reasoning models.
16a0879cfcb6.tool: The tool role returns the results of tool calls to the model. It is not used for system-level instructions.
16a0879cfcb6.function: The function role is a legacy role for returning function call results. It is not used to give system-level instructions to reasoning models.

597a3689fa27.Set the image detail parameter to high: High detail tiles the image and uses more tokens. It increases cost, the opposite of what is needed.
597a3689fa27.Send images as base64 instead of URLs: Image tokens depend on size and detail level, not on how the image is delivered. Base64 encoding does not reduce token cost.
597a3689fa27.Upscale images to 2048 px before sending: Larger images use more tiles and more tokens in high detail. Upscaling would raise cost without improving simple photos.

dc02dea9e1ef.Increase the TPM quota of the deployment: More quota adds throughput in the same region. It does nothing if that whole region is unavailable.
dc02dea9e1ef.Deploy a second resource and switch clie: A second region helps, but manually changing the client endpoint requires client changes. A gateway keeps one endpoint and fails over automatically.
dc02dea9e1ef.Add a private endpoint for the deploymen: A private endpoint is only a network path to the same regional resource. If that region fails, the deployment is still down.

043b337d68ef.Strict mode requires every string to als: Strings do not need to be nullable in strict mode. Null unions are only used to model optional fields.
043b337d68ef.additionalProperties must be set to true: Strict mode requires additionalProperties to be false. Setting it to true would make the schema invalid.
043b337d68ef.The string field must also declare a def: default is not a supported keyword in strict structured outputs. The actual problem is the unsupported minLength keyword.

34c3671753d8.Remove it from required and keep additio: In strict mode every property must be listed in required. Removing a field from required makes the schema invalid.
34c3671753d8.Wrap the field in anyOf at the root of t: The root of a strict schema must be an object and cannot be anyOf. Optional fields are modeled with a null union instead.
34c3671753d8.Give the field a default value of null i: default is not supported in strict structured outputs. The field must stay in required with a type that includes null.

fdb155694036.Set tool_choice to required: required forces the model to call at least one tool. It does not stop the model from calling two tools at once.
fdb155694036.Set tool_choice to auto explicitly: auto is already the default behavior and still allows parallel tool calls. The parsing issue would remain.
fdb155694036.Add additionalProperties true to schemas: Strict schemas require additionalProperties false. Setting it to true breaks strict mode and does not address parallel calls.

ad5a5fb5719a.strict to true on that function schema: strict makes the arguments follow the schema exactly. It does not force the model to call the function.
ad5a5fb5719a.parallel_tool_calls to false on the requ: This only limits the model to one tool call at a time. The model can still answer directly without calling any tool.
ad5a5fb5719a.tool_choice to auto with the function li: auto lets the model decide whether to call a tool. It can still answer directly, so it does not force the call.

5b0ccff469ec.An assistant message containing the resu: The assistant role holds the model's own replies, including its tool calls. Tool results must be sent in a message with the tool role.
5b0ccff469ec.A user message containing the result and: Sending the result as a user message does not link it to the tool call. The API expects a tool message with the matching tool_call_id.
5b0ccff469ec.A system message containing the result a: System messages carry instructions, not tool results. The result goes in a tool role message with the tool_call_id.

916a7244167f.A hosted agent: Hosted agents run your own containerized code. The requirement is for declarative orchestration, which workflow agents provide.
916a7244167f.A prompt agent: A prompt agent is a single agent defined by instructions and tools. It does not provide declarative branching across specialist agents with human approval steps.
916a7244167f.A connected agent: Connected agents let a main agent delegate to other agents as tools. They do not provide declarative branching and human-in-the-loop steps.

e03d9c3f4edb.A workflow agent: Workflow agents are declarative orchestrations built in Foundry. They do not run your own LangGraph container code.
e03d9c3f4edb.A prompt agent: Prompt agents are defined by instructions, a model and tools in Foundry. They do not host your own container.
e03d9c3f4edb.A connected agent: Connected agents are agents invoked as tools by another agent. They do not run custom container code with its own networking.

255474ff55cf.Add a scoring profile that boosts recent: Boosting newer documents only reorders what is in the index. The index still holds yesterday's prices until it is refreshed.
255474ff55cf.Enable the semantic ranker so the newest: The semantic ranker reranks by meaning, not by freshness. It cannot surface prices that are not yet indexed.
255474ff55cf.Raise the indexer batch size so the nigh: Batch size changes how many documents are processed per batch, not how often the indexer runs. Prices still update only nightly.

f0eac43e28ad.Groundedness high but retrieval relevanc: That pattern would mean the retrieved content is poor. Here retrieval returns the right chunks, so relevance is high and groundedness is low.
f0eac43e28ad.Fluency high but coherence low points to: Fluency and coherence are text-quality metrics. They do not measure whether claims are supported by the retrieved context.
f0eac43e28ad.Response completeness high but retrieval: The question states retrieval returns the right chunks, so retrieval relevance is not low. Completeness also does not measure unsupported claims.

a3e96f2c3be8.Move the full history into the system me: Moving the full history into the system message still sends all of it. The prompt keeps growing and costs keep rising.
a3e96f2c3be8.Switch to a model with a larger context: A larger window delays the limit but keeps every turn in each request. Costs keep rising and the history still grows.
a3e96f2c3be8.Raise max_completion_tokens so the model: max_completion_tokens limits the output length. It does not reduce the input history or help the model keep earlier instructions.

a1ed75a96427.Ask the model to list sources it remembe: Sources recalled from training data are unreliable and can be invented. They are not the passages actually retrieved for the answer.
a1ed75a96427.Fine-tune the model on the source docume: Fine-tuning does not let a model reliably cite exact passages. Citations need the retrieved chunks with identifiers in the prompt.
a1ed75a96427.Set the semantic ranker to return answer: An index name does not identify the passage used. Each chunk needs its own source ID that the model cites.

9c98cd9f627b.Raise the TPM quota so repeated tool cal: More quota lets the loop run without throttling but does not stop it. Cost and latency stay high.
9c98cd9f627b.Switch to a model with a larger context: A larger context window holds more tool results but does not stop repeated calls. The loop continues.
9c98cd9f627b.Enable parallel_tool_calls so the ten se: Running calls in parallel may reduce wall time but still makes ten calls. It does not fix the runaway loop or the cost.

db8cdf2c1f1a.The source image and a mask whose opaque: The mask works the other way round. The transparent area marks the region to regenerate, and opaque areas are kept.
db8cdf2c1f1a.The source image and a JSON bounding box: The image edit API does not take a bounding box. The edit region is defined with a mask image.
db8cdf2c1f1a.Only the edited prompt, with the label p: Without the source image and a mask, the model creates a new image. Pixel coordinates in the prompt do not limit the edit to one region.

ac81ba5b0e83.Lower the image detail setting so embedd: Low detail can still read large text and does not treat it as untrusted. It is not a defense against prompt injection.
ac81ba5b0e83.Run OCR first and pass the extracted tex: Placing the untrusted text in the system message gives it more authority. That makes the injection more likely to succeed.
ac81ba5b0e83.Enable protected material detection for: Protected material detection looks for copyrighted text in output. It does not detect injected instructions.

b37dda30ab75.Generate: Generate creates free-form values such as summaries or descriptions. It does not restrict output to the fixed labels complaint, inquiry or praise.
b37dda30ab75.Translate: Translate is not one of the Content Understanding field methods, which are extract, classify and generate. Translating a recording would not assign it a category anyway.
b37dda30ab75.Extract: Extract pulls values that appear directly in the content, such as names or dates. Labelling each call into predefined categories is a classification task.

65cc4bed4a2c.Classify: Classify assigns content to predefined categories. A free-form scene description is not chosen from a fixed list.
65cc4bed4a2c.OCR: Optical character recognition (OCR) reads text that is visible in images or frames. The description does not appear as text in the video, so there is nothing to read.
65cc4bed4a2c.Extract: Extract only returns values that appear directly in the content. The scene description is not present anywhere, so it has to be generated.

072dac7ab445.enableFormula to return the source formu: enableFormula extracts mathematical formulas from documents. It does not return where each field came from or how confident the model was.
072dac7ab445.A classify field method that adds a conf: Classify assigns content to predefined categories. It does not return a source region and confidence score for each extracted value.
072dac7ab445.enableFigureDescription to describe the: Figure descriptions produce text for charts and images. They do not provide grounding and confidence for each field.

7d1cd74ec627.Use the classify field method to tag pag: Tagging pages with a category does not turn chart content into searchable text. The charts' meaning is still missing from the index.
7d1cd74ec627.Use layout table extraction to convert e: Table extraction handles tables in the document, not charts. Charts and diagrams need figure descriptions to become text.
7d1cd74ec627.Use formula extraction so chart values b: Formula extraction captures mathematical formulas. It does not describe charts or diagrams.

99842622ee60.The text severity threshold for the viol: Text thresholds apply to text content. Uploaded images are evaluated by the image filters, which have their own severity thresholds.
99842622ee60.The image severity threshold for the sel: Self-harm covers content about hurting oneself. Weapons fall under the violence category.
99842622ee60.A blocklist of weapon terms attached to: Blocklists match text terms and do not score images by severity. They cannot allow low severity images while blocking high severity ones.

071f2247fd55.Protected material detection applied to: Protected material detection looks for known copyrighted content. It does not mark images as AI-generated.
071f2247fd55.The revised_prompt field returned with e: revised_prompt shows the prompt the model actually used. It is not attached to the image as a disclosure.
071f2247fd55.Content filter annotations stored in the: Content filter annotations are returned in the API response, not written into the image. They report harm categories, not AI provenance.

d4c2f2f4280a.SSML with prosody and emphasis elements: Prosody changes rate, pitch and volume, and emphasis stresses words. They do not set exact pronunciation or insert pauses like phoneme and break.
d4c2f2f4280a.A phrase list with the product names: Phrase lists improve speech to text recognition. They do not affect how synthesized speech pronounces words.
d4c2f2f4280a.Custom speech with a pronunciation file: Custom speech pronunciation files help recognition. They do not control text to speech output.

e09a305c3e65.Add the part numbers to an SSML lexicon: SSML lexicons affect text to speech pronunciation. They do not change how speech to text recognizes words.
e09a305c3e65.Enable speaker diarization on the stream: Diarization separates speakers in a transcript. It does not improve recognition of specific terms.
e09a305c3e65.Switch to batch transcription with times: Batch transcription uses the same recognition models. It does not boost recognition of specific part numbers.

2c75fe3d4d29.Custom neural voice is available to any: Custom neural voice is a limited access feature. Microsoft must approve an application before it can be used.
2c75fe3d4d29.Custom neural voice needs only a phrase: Phrase lists are a speech to text feature. Custom neural voice requires approved access and verified consent from the voice talent.
2c75fe3d4d29.Custom neural voice requires a provision: Provisioned throughput applies to Azure OpenAI model deployments. Custom neural voice requires limited access approval and talent consent.

83837d4b7a4d.Translator text translation: Text translation translates strings, not whole files. Layout and formatting of the Word documents would be lost.
83837d4b7a4d.Speech translation in batch mode: Speech translation works on audio input. It does not translate Word documents.
83837d4b7a4d.Content Understanding document extractio: Content Understanding extracts content and fields from documents. It does not produce translated Word files with formatting kept.

db40244562ee.A phrase list with the company terms: Phrase lists boost speech to text recognition. They do not control how Translator renders terms.
db40244562ee.An SSML lexicon for the product terms: SSML lexicons change text to speech pronunciation. They do not affect translation output.
db40244562ee.Automatic language detection on input: Language detection identifies the source language. It does not enforce terminology or protect terms from translation.

30d3298824ca.Word-level timestamps in speech to text: Timestamps show when each word was spoken. They do not identify which speaker said it.
30d3298824ca.Language identification in speech to tex: Language identification detects which language is spoken. It does not separate speakers.
30d3298824ca.Phrase lists for each speaker's name: Phrase lists improve recognition of specific words. They do not attribute lines to speakers.

397078dc02ac.Named entity recognition results with en: Named entity recognition finds general entities and returns no redacted text. PII detection is needed to redact personal data.
397078dc02ac.PII detection with redactionPolicy set t: The noMask policy returns the text without masking. The transcripts must be redacted, so this does not meet the requirement.
397078dc02ac.Key phrase extraction results with confi: Key phrase extraction returns main talking points and does not redact anything. It does not identify PII entities.

9778c19d42ae.Add a regex pattern keyword for the date: pattern is listed as an unsupported keyword for strings in strict structured outputs. Format must be enforced in code after parsing.
9778c19d42ae.Use JSON mode and ask for ISO 8601 dates: JSON mode only ensures valid JSON, not a schema or date format. The model can still return mixed formats.
9778c19d42ae.Add few-shot examples of ISO dates and p: Examples improve consistency but do not guarantee it. Parsing free text is less reliable than a strict schema plus normalization.

6502240af9a3.Weighted sum of BM25 and cosine: Azure AI Search does not add raw BM25 and cosine scores. The scores are on different scales, so it uses Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
6502240af9a3.Min-max normalized score fusion: Hybrid search does not normalize and blend scores. It merges results by rank using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
6502240af9a3.Keyword results, then vector results: Results are not appended one list after the other. Both rankings are merged into one list with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

9e725cbc5413.10, to keep semantic reranking latency l: A k of 10 gives the semantic ranker few candidates to rerank. The recommendation is 50 to maximize its inputs.
9e725cbc5413.1000, so the ranker scores every candida: The semantic ranker only reranks the top 50 results. Extra candidates beyond that are not reranked.
9e725cbc5413.Equal to top, so only returned results a: Matching k to a small top limits the ranker's input. A k of 50 is recommended so it has enough candidates.

86679b5858ed.A filter with vectorFilterMode set to po: Post-filtering runs the vector search first and filters afterwards, so neighbors are chosen from all documents and you may get fewer than k allowed results. The scenario requires filtering before the search.
86679b5858ed.A filter with vectorFilterMode set to st: strictPostFilter also applies the filter after the vector search. Nearest neighbors are still chosen from all documents, not only allowed ones.
86679b5858ed.A scoring profile with a tag boost on de: Scoring profiles boost relevance but do not exclude documents. The vector search would still consider documents from other departments.

fec8cfa44d1b.orderby disables the vector part of the: The vector query still runs. The explicit sort replaces the relevance order of the merged results.
fec8cfa44d1b.RRF is skipped unless a filter is also p: RRF does not depend on filters. It is the explicit orderby that overrides relevance ranking.
fec8cfa44d1b.Date fields reset the BM25 scores to zer: Sorting by a date field does not change BM25 scores. It just orders results by date instead of relevance.

74f49f0f08d4.Scalar quantization to int8 with rescori: Scalar quantization reduces vector size about four times. Binary quantization gives a much larger reduction, up to 28 times.
74f49f0f08d4.The Edm.Half field type with stored set: Half precision halves vector size and stored false removes the retrievable copy. That saves less than binary quantization.
74f49f0f08d4.Adding partitions to spread the vector i: Partitions add storage capacity and cost. They do not shrink the vectors.

4d0ac1544fd3.It reranks the compressed candidates wit: The semantic ranker reranks text results and is not part of quantization recovery. Accuracy is recovered by rescoring with the original vectors.
4d0ac1544fd3.It rebuilds the HNSW graph with a higher: efConstruction is an index build setting and is not changed per query. Recovery uses oversampling and rescoring.
4d0ac1544fd3.It runs exhaustive KNN over the quantize: Exhaustive KNN over compressed vectors still uses lower precision values. Search uses oversampling and rescoring with the originals.

ae4864bf7931.quantizedDataType set to int8 with scala: Scalar quantization lowers the precision of each value but keeps all dimensions. It does not shorten the vectors.
ae4864bf7931.dimensions on the Azure OpenAI embedding: The dimensions setting asks the model for shorter embeddings. That requires re-embedding all documents.
ae4864bf7931.stored set to false on the vector field: stored false drops the retrievable copy of the vectors. The indexed vectors keep their full dimensions.

3a99c441a1de.The same vector query with efSearch rais: A larger efSearch improves recall but HNSW is still approximate. It does not return guaranteed exact neighbors.
3a99c441a1de.The same vector query with rescoring ena: Rescoring improves ranking of approximate candidates. The results are still not exact ground truth.
3a99c441a1de.A hybrid query with RRF over keyword and: A hybrid query mixes keyword results into the ranking. It does not give the exact vector nearest neighbors.

64cb908b18a8.An embedding skill in the indexer skills: An embedding skill runs only during indexing. Query text needs a vectorizer in the vector profile.
64cb908b18a8.A semantic configuration on the index: A semantic configuration sets fields for the semantic ranker. It does not convert query text to vectors.
64cb908b18a8.An index projection on the skillset: Index projections map chunks to a search index during indexing. They have no role at query time.

01949afcef78.As an Azure OpenAI embedding skill in th: The Azure OpenAI embedding skill calls an Azure OpenAI embedding model. Your own function is called with a custom Web API skill.
01949afcef78.As a custom vectorizer in the index's ve: A custom vectorizer runs at query time to vectorize queries. It does not enrich documents during indexing.
01949afcef78.As a field mapping on the indexer that p: Field mappings map source fields to index fields. They cannot call an external endpoint.

a495281a8ebc.Increase the chunk overlap so neighborin: Overlap repeats nearby text between chunks. Chunks without a title still lack the document context.
a495281a8ebc.Add a scoring profile that boosts matche: Scoring profiles only boost fields that exist in each indexed document. Chunks that lost their title still cannot be told apart.
a495281a8ebc.Use a larger embedding model so each chu: A larger model cannot embed information that is not in the chunk. The title must be added to the chunk text.
